page: Microsoft Azure E64as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eav6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable for external block storage integration.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64as_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core and memory performance. The Geekbench multi-core test places this instance in the top tier (top 10%) with a score of 21,907.0, complemented by top-tier image processing capabilities and small-model LLM prompt processing speeds of 4,447.51 tokens per second. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance for write operations on large blocks at 108.95 GB/sec and small cached reads at 4,863.52 GB/sec, though large-block uncached reads perform at an average tier. Additionally, the processor's support for AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptography acceleration contributes to strong scores in Passmark CPU and encryption tests.

Given its high memory density and dedicated AMD EPYC compute resources, the E64as_v6 offers a balanced cost-to-resource profile for memory-intensive enterprise workloads without the overhead of local NVMe drives. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for tailored external storage configurations. This hardware profile is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, software compilation, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure E64as_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eav6 family, featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs (32 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores) running at 3.7 GHz and 512.0 GB of RAM. Lacking local storage and GPUs, this Premium Storage-capable instance is designed for external storage attachment. Benchmarks highlight top-tier multi-core performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score in the top 10% and strong memory write bandwidth of 108.95 GB/sec. It also excels in cryptography and database operations, as evidenced by a Redis SET throughput of 88.78 million operations per second. The E64as_v6 is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-heavy workloads, making it highly suitable for enterprise databases, in-memory analytics, and large-scale software compilation.
